newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market anxious over currency.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market anxious over currency.

text.p: Anxiety clouded activity in the Bradford wool market over the strength of the pound sterling.
But there was some evidence that short-term demand for textiles including carpets had helped to keep up the call for deliveries.
The worry was that a stronger sterling and the potential for higher interest rates could lead to a reversal and see import competition gaining ground, some participants said.
Topmakers quotations were unchanged to three pence down.
New commitments are being treated more cautiously as the general sentiment was one of sitting back and postponing decisions, possibly due to the approach of the Christmas break.
